metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented in `/workspace/output` and verified with the requested build.

- [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp#L306) dispatches `inspect`, `render`, `inspect_gedzip`, and `render_gedzip`, validates the request shape, and rewrites `gedcom.ged` references when a GEDZIP attachment would conflict.
- [gedcom_impl.cpp](/workspace/output/gedcom_impl.cpp#L422) and [gedcom_impl.cpp](/workspace/output/gedcom_impl.cpp#L833) parse GEDCOM into the canonical tree, fold `CONT` lines into payload strings, validate datasets, and render back to GEDCOM text.
- [zip.cpp](/workspace/output/zip.cpp#L181) and [zip.cpp](/workspace/output/zip.cpp#L487) read and write ZIP archives, including valid central directory records and raw deflate support for incoming GEDZIP files.
- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt#L3) builds `gedtool` as a C++20 executable with only the standard library.

Verified:
- `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`
- GEDCOM inspect/render round-trip
- GEDZIP inspect/render round-trip
- Incoming deflated ZIP archives produced by Python `zipfile`
